# HMS 故障码 / HMS codes · 18

[返回索引 / Index](../../HMS-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| 屏幕错误码 / Code | 中文说明 / Chinese | English description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HMS 1886-2000-0002-0058` | 无法识别AMS-HT G 料卷的标签内容。 | The RFID-tag on AMS-HT G cannot be identified. |
| `HMS 1887-2000-0002-0058` | 无法识别AMS-HT H 料卷的标签内容。 | The RFID-tag on AMS-HT H cannot be identified. |
| `HMS 18FE-2000-0002-0001` | 左挤出机外部挂载的耗材用完；请装入新的耗材。 | External filament of left extruder has run out; please load a new filament. |
| `HMS 18FE-2000-0002-0002` | 未发现左挤出机外部挂载的耗材；请装入新的耗材。 | No filament was detected in the left extruder from the external spool; please load the new filament. |
| `HMS 18FE-2000-0002-0004` | 请从左挤出机中拉出外部挂载的耗材。 | Please pull the external filament from the left extruder. |
| `HMS 18FE-4500-0002-0002` | 切刀刀柄行程异常，可能切刀触发杆跳齿、电机丢步或XY未回零。 | The filament cutter's cutting distance is too large. Possible causes include the filament cutter stopper skipping teeth, motor losing steps, or the XY axis not being homed. |
| `HMS 18FE-4500-0002-0003` | 切刀刀柄未松开，刀柄或刀片可能被卡住，或耗材霍尔接线异常。 | The filament cutter handle has not been released. The handle or blade may be jammed, or there could be an issue with the filament sensor connection. |
| `HMS 18FE-6000-0002-0001` | 左挤出机外部挂载的耗材缠绕或料盘卡住。 | External spool connected to left extruder may be tangled or jammed. |
| `HMS 18FE-7000-0002-0003` | 请检查耗材是否从左喷嘴挤出。如未挤出，请轻推耗材后重试 | Please check if the material is coming out of the left nozzle. If not, gently push the material and try to extrude again. |
| `HMS 18FE-7000-0002-0008` | 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。 | Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry. |
| `HMS 18FE-7000-0002-000A` | 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。 | Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0001-0001` | 工具头升降电机工作异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。 | The toolhead lift motor works abnormally. Please check whether the connecting cable is loose. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0001-0002` | 工具头升降电机位置霍尔传感器断路，请检查连接排线是否松动。 | The Toolhead Lifting Motor position hall sensor has an open circuit; please check whether the connecting cable is loose. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0001-0003` | 工具头升降电机位置霍尔信号异常，可能是工具头内部通信故障。 | The hall signal of the Toolhead Lifting Motor is abnormal, possibly due to internal communication failure in the Toolhead module. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0001-0004` | 工具头升降电机位置霍尔传感器短路，请检查霍尔传感器是否异常。 | The Toolhead Lifting Motor position hall sensor is short-circuited; please check if the Hall sensor is malfunctioning. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0001-0005` | 挤出机切换限位角度发生较大偏移，请检查堵嘴片是否卡住或是否有耗材卡在工具头内。 | The extruder's switching limit angle has drifted significantly. Please check if the flow blocker is jammed or if filament is stuck in the toolhead. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0001-0006` | 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。 | The TH board disconnected during the extruder switching process. Please check if the connecting cable is loose. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0002-0001` | 挤出机切换过程中升降动作异常，请检查堵嘴片是否卡住或是否有耗材卡在工具头内。 | The lifting action is abnormal during the extruder switch. Please check whether the flow blocker is stuck or there is filament stuck in the toolhead. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0002-0002` | 打印过程中左热端位置异常，请检查堵嘴片是否剐蹭打印模型。 | The position of left hotend is abnormal during printing. Please check whether the flow blocker scratches the printed model. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0002-0003` | 挤出机位置校准数值偏差过大，请重新校准。 | The deviation in the positioning calibration value of the extruder is too large; please recalibrate. |
| `HMS 18FE-8000-0002-0004` | 检测到辅助挤出机热端位置异常。请检查堵嘴片是否剐蹭打印模型，或者工具头上方料管是否被挤压。 | Abnormal auxiliary extruder hotend position detected. Check for nozzle wiper contact with the printed model or a pinched filament tube above the toolhead. |

| `HMS 18FE-8100-0001-0006` | 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。 | The TH board disconnected during the extruder switching process. Please check if the connecting cable is loose. |
